name: FireHOL IP lists
tier_rationale: FireHOL, a long-running open-source community project with public documentation that aggregates IP lists (A8 community); P035 and P149 record tier community ('the list maintainers are public community projects').

reliability.justification: Aggregates third-party lists of mixed quality; FireHOL level1 hits are LOW fidelity and never sole evidence (P149), and the proxy sets churn with residential proxies (P035).

level1.title: FireHOL level1 aggregate netset (and level2/3/webclient on request)

terms.quote: Noncommercial, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: blocklist.de, CINS, ET compromised IPs, GreenSnow and DataPlane (A1 BR16), VoIPBL, and the FireHOL level1 aggregate (it embeds noncommercial upstreams such as DShield).

level1.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 2). iplists.firehol.org/files/firehol_level1.netset (research C0353; netset header 2026-11-26: 'includes: dshield feodo fullbogons spamhaus_drop'); level2/level3/webclient on request under the same class. A hit counts as the families it embeds, never as an extra vote (P149, P171 cond 3); bogon/RFC 1918 entries are dropped at load. Refreshed daily through the dataset manager; never redistributed outside the team.
level1.licensed_alternative: The open constituents read directly: Spamhaus DROP/EDROP (P149, open) and abuse.ch Feodo Tracker (core source abusech.feodotracker, open); DShield needs its own SANS ISC licence decision.

proxies.title: FireHOL proxies netset (open-proxy and anonymizer aggregate)

terms.quote: FireHOL proxy ipsets inherit each upstream list's terms and are consumed per upstream (the ipset header names it). Noncommercial upstreams stay off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared; upstreams with unrecorded terms are not wired.

proxies.notes: Quote: binding council text (P035 cond 4). iplists.firehol.org/files/firehol_proxies.netset (research C0112; netset header 2026-11-26: 'includes: iblocklist_proxies ip2proxy_px1lite socks_proxy_30d sslproxies_30d'). Context tag only, never sole evidence; an IP is never tested as an open proxy (P035). Per-upstream sources with recorded terms may be added by extension.
proxies.licensed_alternative: Per-upstream sources whose terms legal records, added by extension (firehol__<suffix>.json) and consumed individually (P035).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G02-2, p2-G02-1: batches only extend it (firehol__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Aggregator: each source lists the families it embeds (P171 cond 3) so consensus never counts FireHOL twice; the aggregate class is noncommercial (P149, P035). Lists refresh daily; no value leaves the machine. The raw.githubusercontent.com mirror belongs to core provider github (extend it there).
